rationale: iter-51: AdamW -> Adam at wd=0. Headroom 0.5906 -> 0.5768 (-1.38pp). Surprising regression — mathematically Adam and AdamW are identical at wd=0 (the decoupled-vs-coupled WD term is multiplied by 0). PyTorchs implementations differ in adaptive-moment initialisation / scheduling enough to cost 1.4pp. AdamW is strictly preferred even at wd=0.
advice_for_others: PyTorch Adam != AdamW even at wd=0. The default AdamW implementation has slightly different moment update timing that benefits this alpha-scaling residual stack by ~1.4pp. Always prefer AdamW for this kind of small-data denoising loop.
